text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a cat or a dog. Another task is object detection, which finds and locates multiple objects in an image. These technologies have many applications in daily life. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to see the road, recognize traffic signs, and detect pedestrians. This helps the car drive safely without a human driver. Computer vision is also used in security cameras, medical imaging, and shopping apps. It is changing the way machines understand the world.
